v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

source.scope: Psalmi & antiphonæ ex Psalterio secundum diem

text.la: Ecce sacérdos magnus, qui in diébus suis plácuit Deo, et invéntus est iustus: et in témpore iracúndiæ factus est reconciliátio.
text.en: Behold an high priest, who in his days pleased God, and was found righteous, and in the time of wrath he was made a propitiation.

v.la: Iustum dedúxit Dóminus per vias rectas, allelúia.
v.en: The Lord guided the just in right paths, alleluia.

r.la: Et osténdit illi regnum Dei, allelúia.
r.en: And showed him the kingdom of God, alleluia.

text.la: O Doctor óptime, * Ecclésiæ sanctæ lumen, beáte Athanási, divínæ legis amátor, deprecáre pro nobis Fílium Dei, allelúia.
text.en: O right excellent Teacher * Light of the Holy Church, Athanasius, blessed lover of the Divine Law, pray for us to the Son of God, alleluia.

text.la: Exáudi, quǽsumus, Dómine, preces nostras, quas in beáti Athanásii Confessóris tui atque Pontíficis solemnitáte deférimus: et, qui tibi digne méruit famulári, eius intercedéntibus méritis, ab ómnibus nos absólve peccátis.
text.en: Hear, O Lord, we beseech thee, the prayers which we offer thee on this the solemn feast-day of thy blessed Confessor and bishop Athanasius, and, for the sake of him who so nobly served thee, forgive us our trespasses.

office.title: S. Athanasii Episcopi Confessoris et Ecclesiæ Doctoris
